versos.grego: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικίᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί,

controles.web: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
controles.kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
controles.livre: Pois quero que saibais como é grande a luta que tenho para o benefício de vós, dos que estão em Laodiceia, e de tantos quantos não viram meu rosto fisicamente;

versos.grego: ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν, συνβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς πᾶν πλοῦτος τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως, εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ, Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
controles.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
controles.livre: para que os seus corações sejam consolados, e estejam unidos em amor, e em todas as riquezas da pleno entendimento, para conhecimento do mistério de Deus: Cristo.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως ἀπόκρυφοι.

controles.web: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.
controles.kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
controles.livre: Nele estão ocultos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e do conhecimento.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο λέγω ἵνα μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς παραλογίζηται ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ.

controles.web: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
controles.kjv: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
controles.livre: Digo isso para que ninguém vos engane com palavras persuasivas.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι, ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι, χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν.

controles.web: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
controles.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
controles.livre: Pois ainda que esteja ausente em corpo, todavia em espírito estou convosco, alegrando-me, e vendo a vossa ordem e a firmeza de vossa fé em Cristo.

versos.grego: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν Κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε,

controles.web: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
controles.kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
controles.livre: Portanto, assim como recebestes Cristo Jesus, o Senhor, assim também andai nele;

versos.grego: ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.

controles.web: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
controles.kjv: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
controles.livre: com raízes firmes e edificados nele, e confirmados na fé, como fostes ensinados, abundando com gratidão.

versos.grego: Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν·

controles.web: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.
controles.kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
controles.livre: Cuidado que ninguém vos tome cativos por meio de filosofias e de enganos vãos, conforme a tradição humana, conforme os elementos do mundo, e não conforme Cristo.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς Θεότητος σωματικῶς,

controles.web: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,
controles.kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
controles.livre: Pois nele habita corporalmente toda a plenitude da divindade.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας,

controles.web: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;
controles.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
controles.livre: E vós vos tornais plenos nele, que é o cabeça de todo governo e autoridade.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;
controles.kjv: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
controles.livre: Nele também fostes circuncidados com uma circuncisão não feita por mãos, mas sim , no abandono do corpo da carne,  pela circuncisão de Cristo;

versos.grego: συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτίσματι, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν·

controles.web: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
controles.kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
controles.livre: sepultados com ele no batismo, no qual também com ele fostes ressuscitados pela fé no poder de Deus, que o ressuscitou dos mortos.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ, χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα,

controles.web: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
controles.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
controles.livre: E quando vós estáveis mortos em pecados, na incircuncisão da vossa carne, Deus vos deu vida juntamente com ele, perdoando-vos todas as ofensas.

versos.grego: ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου, προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ·

controles.web: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;
controles.kjv: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
controles.livre: Ele riscou a certidão de nossa dívida em ordenanças, a qual era contra nós, e a removeu, cravando-a na cruz;

versos.grego: ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ, θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
controles.kjv: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
controles.livre: ele despojou os domínios e autoridades, publicamente os envergonhou, e nela triunfou sobre eles.

versos.grego: Μὴ οὖν τις ὑμᾶς κρινέτω ἐν βρώσει καὶ ἐν πόσει ἢ ἐν μέρει ἑορτῆς ἢ νεομηνίας ἢ σαββάτων,

controles.web: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
controles.kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
controles.livre: Portanto, ninguém vos julgue pelo comer, ou pelo beber, ou por causa de celebração religiosa , ou pela lua nova, ou pelos sábados;

versos.grego: ἅ ἐστιν σκιὰ τῶν μελλόντων, τὸ δὲ σῶμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
controles.kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
controles.livre: essas coisas são a sombra das coisas futuras, mas a realidade  pertence a Cristo.

versos.grego: μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς καταβραβευέτω θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ θρησκείᾳ τῶν ἀγγέλων, ἃ ἑόρακεν ἐμβατεύων, εἰκῇ φυσιούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ νοὸς τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
controles.kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
controles.livre: Ninguém, pois, se faça de juiz contra vós, insistindo nos pretextos de “humildade” e de “culto aos anjos”  , envolvendo-se em suas “visões”,  vangloriando-se em sua mentalidade carnal,

versos.grego: καὶ οὐ κρατῶν τὴν Κεφαλήν, ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα διὰ τῶν ἁφῶν καὶ συνδέσμων ἐπιχορηγούμενον καὶ συνβιβαζόμενον αὔξει τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
controles.kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
controles.livre: e não se ligando à cabeça, da qual todo o corpo, suprido e organizado pelas juntas e ligamentos, vai crescendo com o crescimento da parte de Deus.

versos.grego: Εἰ ἀπεθάνετε σὺν Χριστῷ ἀπὸ τῶν στοιχείων τοῦ κόσμου, τί ὡς ζῶντες ἐν κόσμῳ δογματίζεσθε

controles.web: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
controles.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
controles.livre: Se estais mortos com Cristo para os elementos do mundo, por que vos sujeitais a ordenanças como se vivêsseis no mundo,

versos.grego: Μὴ ἅψῃ μηδὲ γεύσῃ μηδὲ θίγῃς,

controles.web: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
controles.kjv: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
controles.livre: tais como : “não pegues”, “não proves”, “não toques”?

versos.grego: ἅ ἐστιν πάντα εἰς φθορὰν τῇ ἀποχρήσει, κατὰ τὰ ἐντάλματα καὶ διδασκαλίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων;

controles.web: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
controles.kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
controles.livre: Todas elas se acabam com o uso, e se baseiam em mandamentos e doutrinas humanas.

versos.grego: ἅτινά ἐστιν λόγον μὲν ἔχοντα σοφίας ἐν ἐθελοθρησκίᾳ καὶ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀφειδίᾳ σώματος, οὐκ ἐν τιμῇ τινι πρὸς πλησμονὴν τῆς σαρκός.

controles.web: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
controles.kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
controles.livre: Elas realmente têm aparência de sabedoria em culto voluntário, humildade, e tratamento severo ao corpo; mas não têm valor algum contra a satisfação da carne.
